name: A New Need for Shadow Protection
summary: Mirda needs Greater Shadow Protection Potions for Magram clanmates venturing south toward the Valley of Bones. Bring them to her in Magram Village while keeping the clan’s trust.

sections.title: Mirda's Request
sections.body: Mirda in Magram Village needs you to bring her Greater Shadow Protection Potions. Magram clanmates are traveling farther south, toward and beyond the Valley of Bones. Mirda says the potions are needed to help keep them alive, and asks you to bring three while maintaining your standing with the clan.

faq.q: Who is asking for the potions?
faq.answer: Mirda in Magram Village asks you to bring her Greater Shadow Protection Potions.

faq.q: Why does Mirda need the potions?
faq.answer: Magram clanmates are venturing south toward and beyond the Valley of Bones, and Mirda says the potions are needed for their continued survival.

faq.q: Where do I bring the potions?
faq.answer: Bring the potions to Mirda in Magram Village in Desolace.

faq.q: How many potions does Mirda need?
faq.answer: Mirda asks for three Greater Shadow Protection Potions.

faq.q: What does Mirda say about the clanmates' ventures?
faq.answer: Mirda does not trust you enough to share details about the clanmates' ventures.

faq.q: What must I maintain with the Magram?
faq.answer: You need to maintain your reputation with the Magram while bringing the potions to Mirda.

attribution: In-game quest text: A New Need for Shadow Protection
